description: Header file defining interfaces for UBUS communication within the BBFDM context, including initialization, invocation (sync and async), and event sending functions, along with related macros.

methods.name: bbfdm_init_ubus_ctx
methods.description: Initializes the UBUS context within the BBFDM context.

methods.name: bbfdm_free_ubus_ctx
methods.description: Frees the UBUS context within the BBFDM context.

methods.name: bbfdm_ubus_invoke_sync
methods.description: Invokes a UBUS method synchronously with a callback for response handling.

methods.name: bbfdm_ubus_invoke_async
methods.description: Invokes a UBUS method asynchronously with data and completion callbacks.

methods.name: bbfdm_ubus_send_event
methods.description: Sends an event to a specified UBUS object.
